messages:
Maya: Heads up — final RN draft is ready for internal review. Need sign-off + timing for the internal blast. Targeting Wed 09:00 PT. /cc @Jon
Jon: Wed 09:00 PT works for me, but can we shift 15m later in case the canary needs extra validation?
Sara: I prefer 09:15 PT so ops has time to run the smoke checks after canary.
eng-release-bot: deploy scheduled: canary -> 2025-06-15T08:30:00Z, ramp at +30m if healthy. Canary policy: p50 < 120ms, error_rate < 0.1% over 5m window.
Alex: RN copy looks solid. Suggest adding a short "What to watch" bullet: model latency regression and KV cache miss rate spike.
Maya: Added that. Pushing new draft below:
```
Release notes (internal):
- Service: Redwood API inference runtime
- Version: v2.3.7
- Highlights: improved batching heuristics, KV cache warmup improvements, quantization tuning
- What to watch: sudden increase in token latency, KV cache miss rate > 5%, error rate > 0.1%
- Rollback plan: primary rollback to v2.3.6; see runbook for fallback lanes
```
Release Captain: Rollback ladder confirmed: 1) rollback to v2.3.6 (standard deploy rollback) 2) if rollback fails, route traffic to model-proxy fallback and escalate to oncall SRE 3) open incident and follow playbook.
Jon: For Dedicated customers we should pin to v2.3.6 for the first 2 hours post-deploy, then lift pin if metrics stable. Can ops make that a 2-hour post-canary gating step?
Sara: Ops can enforce 2-hr pin for Dedicated. Also please include the healthcheck curl in RN so support can run it quickly:
```
curl -sS https://internal.health/realtime-check | jq '.ok, .latency_ms'
```
eng-release-bot: canary metrics update: 4/4 health checks passed after 18m, p50=95ms, error_rate=0.03% (snapshot @ +18m).
Maya: OK, moving internal blast to 09:15 PT. Draft internal announcement (short):
"Heads up — deploying v2.3.7 to production tomorrow at 09:15 PT. Watch p50 latency and KV cache misses. If you see issues, follow the internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollback"
Alex: Nit: add link directly to the rollback playbook and the incident channel (#incidents).
Maya: Done. Final internal copy below and pinned RN link added. Ready for sign-off. :thumbsup:
Jon: :thumbsup:
Release Captain: :shipit:
Maya: I'll schedule the internal announcement at 09:15 PT and pin the RN to #internal-announce. Thanks everyone!
